name: omagnet
author: Felipe Paiva
description: Settings for omagnet, Magnet-style window snapping for Omarchy floating workspaces. Adds nothing to the bar unless you turn the optional icon on. Open it from the launcher or with: omarchy-shell shell toggle io.github.felipecpaiva.omagnet

barWidget.description: Optional icon that opens the omagnet settings. Stays hidden until you turn it on in the settings window.
